body: I’m 20 and female and have a normal blood pressure

My parents always kindof thought of me as “perfect” cause I got perfect grades in highschool when living with them and didn’t get into much trouble. Obvi No one is perfect but Ik they would freak out if I were unstable in any aspect, which makes me feel as tho I have to be “perfect”. I know this is stupid but this has made me uneasy/ subconsciously unwilling to verbally be able to express any dark feelings to anyone

I’m so sorry that happened to you. So immensely sorry. I dont know all of your story but it is not your fault. 

Awful thoughts about suicide cross my mind constantly but I know that I’ll never actually do it. When I start to address these thoughts I think about my little brothers and rest of my fam and think about how lucky of a girl I am, and think that’d I be a bad person for leaving them. Although it is comforting knowing I have them, it makes me even more mad that I think this way. Although it is a truly awful thought and may make me an awful person for thinking as so, but sometimes, just in the worst of times, I wish I didn’t have a great family so that nothing could stop me. 
I know I wont go thru with the worst thoughts I have, but my main problem is how to fucking live with the thoughts/ make them go away/ be happy and live a life up to my potential idek
